operations.description: A multiget version of the get GIF by ID endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] gifs by id [PATH] gifs [PARAMS] ids [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a random GIF, limited by tag. Excluding the tag parameter will return a random GIF from the GIPHY catalog.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] random gif [PATH] gifs random [PARAMS] rating tag [SCHEMA] image

operations.description: Search all GIPHY GIFs for a word or phrase. Punctuation will be stripped and ignored.  Use a plus or url encode for phrases. Example paul+rudd, ryan+gosling or american+psycho.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search gifs [PATH] gifs search [PARAMS] lang limit offset q rating [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The translate API draws on search, but uses the GIPHY `special sauce` to handle translating from one vocabulary to another. In this case, words and phrases to GIF
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] translate gif [PATH] gifs translate [PARAMS] s [SCHEMA] image

operations.description: Fetch GIFs currently trending online. Hand curated by the GIPHY editorial team.  The data returned mirrors the GIFs showcased on the GIPHY homepage. Returns 25 results by default.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] trending gifs [PATH] gifs trending [PARAMS] limit offset rating [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a GIF given that GIF's unique ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] gif by id [PATH] gifs [PARAMS] gif id [SCHEMA] image

operations.description: Returns a random GIF, limited by tag. Excluding the tag parameter will return a random GIF from the GIPHY catalog.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] random sticker [PATH] stickers random [PARAMS] rating tag [SCHEMA] image

operations.description: Replicates the functionality and requirements of the classic GIPHY search, but returns animated stickers rather than GIFs.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search stickers [PATH] stickers search [PARAMS] lang limit offset q rating [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The translate API draws on search, but uses the GIPHY `special sauce` to handle translating from one vocabulary to another. In this case, words and phrases to GIFs.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] translate sticker [PATH] stickers translate [PARAMS] s [SCHEMA] image

operations.description: Fetch Stickers currently trending online. Hand curated by the GIPHY editorial team. Returns 25 results by default.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] trending stickers [PATH] stickers trending [PARAMS] limit offset rating [SCHEMA]
